summary: Iteration 43 - Share functionality and rate limit UX testing. Frontend: ALL features verified working (share fallback, copy, refine buttons, rate limit UI elements). Backend: 5/6 tests passed. Rate limit test failed due to backend race condition issue.

critical.issue: Rate limit race condition: Counter only incremented AFTER successful AI response (line 6177), not at request start. Multiple concurrent requests can bypass the 5-request limit because the counter isn't incremented until each request completes (~30 seconds)
critical.root_cause: Rate limit counter is incremented after the AI call completes (line 6177) instead of before the call. When 6+ requests are made in rapid succession, they all pass the check at line 6104 because none have been added to the cache yet.
critical.suggested_fix: Move rate limit increment to BEFORE the AI call (line 6099), and decrement on failure. Or use a semaphore/lock-based approach.

rca_of_issue.issue: Rate limit not triggering 429 for 6th concurrent request
reproduction_steps: 2. Make 6+ concurrent requests to POST /api/ai/travel-plan with different destinations
3. All requests succeed instead of 6th returning 429
rca_of_issue.root_cause: Race condition in rate limiting logic. The check (line 6104: if len(requests_list) >= 5) happens BEFORE the AI call, but the counter increment (line 6177: ai_travel_plan_cache[user_key].append(now.isoformat())) happens AFTER the AI call completes (~30 seconds later). During this 30-second window, all concurrent requests see len(requests_list) < 5 and proceed.
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Move the rate limit counter increment to IMMEDIATELY after the check passes (around line 6106), before the AI call. Optionally decrement on failure to prevent false rate limiting.
